turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1*x**b2 to the data in danwood.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 1, b2 = 5. Report every parameter (b1, b2) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD DanWood (public domain), data copied verbatim
